scopeStatement: Reconstruction of only the supplied 16.556-second video, its same-stem platform SRT, the supplied evidence pack, and targeted frames captured directly from that video. Product claims are not externally verified; absent UI, parameters, provenance, identity, and causality are preserved as unknown.

Preserve the setup, change, and result shown for each pairing.
Separate author claims and visual observations from inference and unknowns.

metaGate.rationale: The protocol checked all supplied transcript cues, every visible tool card, every shot and result sequence, motion-dependent state changes, the AI生成 label, editing adjacency, the CUE-004 SRT/burned-in subtitle discrepancy, and the absence of tool UI/parameters. All six card-to-claim-to-result mappings and their setup/result relations are evidenced. The missing DENSE-0024 asset was replaced by direct targeted capture at 16.516 s (TARGET-0076). Remaining uncertainty concerns information the supplied video does not establish, not an unchecked available carrier.
